idea.title: SignalScout — Real-time trend scanner for indie hackers

plan.tagline: Real-time trend scanner for indie hackers to spot profitable opportunities instantly.
plan.problem: Indie hackers waste hours manually checking Reddit, Twitter, and Product Hunt for trending topics, missing time-sensitive opportunities.
plan.solution: CLI tool that aggregates trending signals from multiple sources, filters noise, and alerts you to high-potential niches with one command.
plan.target_market: Solo developers, indie hackers, and small SaaS founders worldwide who rely on organic trend discovery for product ideas.
mvp_features: CLI commands: add, list, report, alert

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: sqlite schema for trends + add/list commands with local scraping

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: generate CSV reports + basic alerting via stdout

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: add --demo mode, --help, error handling, and edge cases

plan.demo_script: Run `signalscout --demo` to see hardcoded trends like 'AI side hustles' and 'no-code tools' with timestamps. Lists top 5 trends in a table format.
